name: TC-288: the sidebar Menu tab opens Menu Availability Management and Manage Menu opens the builder @smoke
description: From the restaurant portal, the sidebar 'Menu' item renders the 'Menu Availability Management' page: the seeded category accordion shows '6 Available'; 'Add or edit items' opens the builder as the portal's ?tab=menu-builder tab (sidebar kept, New Category visible); 'Back to Menu' returns.
descriptionHtml: From the restaurant portal, the sidebar 'Menu' item renders the 'Menu Availability Management' page: the seeded category accordion shows '6 Available'; 'Add or edit items' opens the builder as the portal's ?tab=menu-builder tab (sidebar kept, New Category visible); 'Back to Menu' returns.
